summary: VisionSys AI Inc filed a Form 6-K disclosing the exercise of an additional allocation under a securities purchase agreement from a March 2026 registered direct offering. Non-affiliated institutional investors purchased 946,150 ADSs at $1.00 per ADS, yielding ~$0.946M gross proceeds. The offering was made under an effective shelf registration on Form F-3, with legal opinions from Cayman and US counsel. No special-situation attributes: this is a routine at-the-market takedown under a shelf, not an acquisition, tender, or restructuring. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; monitor future dilutive raises.
